Minimum Green Area (84% for RA-4, §6-205) remains auxiliary evidence and is not converted into maximum lot coverage, since §6-5(34.1)'s definition of Lot Coverage includes buildings, parking, driveways, decks, pools, patios, and terraces -- green area is not shown to be its legal complement.
